project.title: Study of community structure of ammonia oxidizing archaea (AOA), bacteria (AOB), and diazotrophs in rhizosphere soils of three wetland emergent aquatic plant species
project.description: This study aims to reveal the underlying mechanisms of ammonium oxidation and nitrogen-fixation responding to the emergent aquatic plants in wetland.
